description: This file defines the StreamHandler class, a PHP class in the Guzzle HTTP client library responsible for handling HTTP requests using PHP's stream wrapper. It manages request sending, stream creation, error handling, decoding, and supports various transfer options.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: Defines an HTTP handler that uses PHP's stream wrapper to send requests and handle responses, supporting various transfer options, decoding, and error handling.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles sending an HTTP request with specified options, manages request headers, protocols, and exceptions, and initiates response creation.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the 'on_stats' callback with transfer statistics if set.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a Guzzle response object from stream headers and content, handles decoding and headers, and manages response event callbacks.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Determines the sink stream for the response, either using a provided stream or creating a temporary one.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Automatically decodes gzip or deflate encoded responses if configured.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains the source stream into the sink, respecting the content length.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a stream or context resource, handling errors during creation.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource for the HTTP request, handling context options, host resolution, and errors.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves the host to an IP if 'force_ip_resolve' option is used.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Builds the default stream context array based on the request headers and options.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Adds proxy configuration to the request options from the provided proxy URL.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses a proxy URL into components compatible with PHP stream context.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Sets timeout options for the stream context.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Adds crypto method options for TLS connections.

methods.name: add_verify
methods.description: Configures SSL verification options.

methods.name: add_cert
methods.description: Adds SSL certificate options.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Sets a callback for upload progress notifications.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Sets a callback for stream debugging events.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Adds a stream notification callback to the options.

methods.name: callArray
methods.description: Calls an array of functions sequentially with provided arguments.
